name: Chained Valkyria ~Byakusa no Tsuioku~
source:
A former shaman dark elf and a human girl are picked up by a bandit organization. Over these years they developed bonds stronger than blood ones. This is a story about their adventures.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
translation:
一名曾为萨满祭司的黑暗精灵与一名人类女孩被强盗组织收留。多年间，她们建立起比血缘更坚固的羁绊。这是关于她们冒险的故事。

[摘自[url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/10/vn-of-month-august-2005-saihate-no-ima.html]vndbreview[/url]]
